aliases: Switch to text for this chat
feature.summary: Lets a person leave live voice and keep going in the same chat by typing. On web the voice screen also has a typed field that sends a normal text turn while the call stays open. iPhone has 'Type instead' to leave the call. In the CLI, spoken text can be edited before sending, and Esc returns to the same typed session.

purpose.what_it_does: Gives a way to move between speaking and typing without losing the conversation. Voice turns are saved as messages in the same chat as typed ones, so ending a call leaves a normal chat to continue (apps/web/features/chat/pages/WebChatPage.tsx:6739-6790).
purpose.why_it_exists: Voice fails or is unwelcome at times: noisy rooms, limits reached, no microphone, sensitive text. The brief requires that unfinished work can continue in text (S48.38). The brief calls typing during voice and transcript editing not applicable, but the code has both on web and the CLI.
purpose.who_uses_it: Web and Desktop users in a voice call, iPhone users in a live call, CLI users in /voice.
problems_solved: A usage limit or error ends the call but the task is not finished.
Names, numbers and code are hard to speak.
A wrong transcript is sent to the assistant (CLI lets the person fix it first).
use_cases: Ask something by voice, then type a precise follow-up in the voice screen on web.
Hit the voice limit, press 'Continue in text', and keep the same chat.
On iPhone tap 'Type instead' to bring up the keyboard in the same chat.
In the CLI press 'e' to edit the transcribed sentence, then Enter to send.

where_to_find_it: Web and public Desktop: the voice screen's pill composer with a text field placeholder 'Type' (aria-label 'Type a message to send as a normal turn') and a round close button 'End voice session' (apps/web/features/chat/components/Voice/VoiceComposer.tsx:9-17, 101-110, 133-145). 'Continue in text' appears in the usage-limit and voice-unavailable rows (apps/web/features/chat/components/Voice/VoiceModeSurface.tsx:330-344).

iPhone: 'Type instead' button (accessibility label 'Switch to text for this chat') at the bottom of the live bar, and 'Type a message instead' inside an error box (apps/mobile/src/features/voice/components/LiveVoiceBar.tsx:418, 704-718).
CLI: /voice (alias /v) in the TUI or REPL; Esc leaves voice mode (apps/cli/src/tui/tui_app.rs:6352-6368; apps/cli/src/voice.rs:178-186).
prerequisites: A started voice session (web: managed Cloud chat; iPhone: Cloud chat; CLI: build with the voice feature, i.e. macOS or Windows release builds) (apps/cli/Cargo.toml:124-132; .github/workflows/release-cli.yml:240-278).
screens_and_controls: Web: text field, mic mute button, close button, 'Add' button 'Open this chat panel' (apps/web/features/chat/components/Voice/VoiceComposer.tsx:11-17, 87-146). Enter sends typed text; Space toggles mute only while the field is empty; Escape ends voice (lines 57-77).
iPhone: 'Type instead', route button, mute, 'End live voice' (apps/mobile/src/features/voice/components/LiveVoiceBar.tsx:704-757).
CLI prompt: '[ENTER to send, 'e' to edit, 'r' to re-record, ESC to discard]' (apps/cli/src/voice.rs:231-236).
journey: Web typing during a call: 1. Start voice mode. 2. Click the 'Type' field and write a message. 3. Press Enter. 4. The call stays open; the message is sent as an ordinary chat turn and the reply is written, not spoken [inferred from apps/web/features/chat/hooks/use-voice-session.ts:893-896].

Web leaving voice: 1. Press the close button, or Escape, or 'Continue in text'. 2. The session closes and settles usage (apps/web/features/chat/hooks/use-voice-session.ts:501-506). 3. The normal composer returns in the same chat (apps/web/features/chat/pages/WebChatPage.tsx:7665-7675, 7793-7805).
iPhone: 1. Tap 'Type instead'. 2. The live bar hides and the chat input gets focus (apps/mobile/app/(app)/chat/[id].tsx:1779-1782). 3. Type in the same chat.

CLI: 1. Run /voice. 2. Hold Space to record, release. 3. Choose Enter, e, r or Esc. 4. Press Esc at the prompt to return to the typed prompt in the same session (apps/cli/src/tui/tui_app.rs:7556-7580).
feedback_and_outputs: Web: typed text is sent through the chat send path; a failed send shows the voice error row with 'Try again' (apps/web/features/chat/hooks/use-voice-session.ts:1004-1014; VoiceModeSurface.tsx:346-361).
Web: spoken turns appear in the message list as they stream and are saved without a model call (apps/web/features/chat/pages/WebChatPage.tsx:6739-6788).
CLI: spoken user messages are marked with a voice transcript label in the TUI history and a 'Voice session ended.' system line (apps/cli/src/tui/tui_app.rs:7566-7578).
iPhone: no message of its own; the chat continues.
settings: Web: Voice settings dialog has 'Chat intelligence', which picks the model setting for typed replies when voice is open (apps/web/features/chat/components/Voice/VoiceSettingsModal.tsx:45-46, 396 area).
CLI: --voice-lang and the default voice language (apps/cli/src/lib.rs:5952-5956).

steps.what_happens: Web: Enter in the voice field calls submitTyped, which marks the state as streaming and calls the chat send path.
The typed message goes through the normal chat pipeline on our servers to the chat's model.
Each final spoken turn is added to the list and saved to the conversation without a model call.
Leaving voice closes the realtime connection, then records the session close and its usage.
iPhone: 'Type instead' hides the bar; the effect cleanup closes the call and settles it.
CLI: audio is recorded locally, then transcribed by the signed-in AGI account, the OpenAI transcription API, or a local whisper binary; the text is sent to the agent session like typed text.
CLI Local privacy mode blocks cloud transcription unless AGIWORKFORCE_VOICE_ALLOW_CLOUD=1.

execution_and_data_flow.models_and_providers: Spoken turns on web use the realtime voice model (managed OpenAI route) for speech and a plan-based backend model for delegated work (apps/web/app/api/voice/live/sessions/route.ts:311-318). A typed turn uses the chat's selected model, or the 'Chat intelligence' choice set in Voice settings (apps/web/features/chat/components/Voice/VoiceSettingsModal.tsx:45). CLI transcription uses AGI managed, OpenAI Whisper API with OPENAI_API_KEY, or a local whisper binary (apps/cli/src/voice.rs:1-6).

access_and_usage.account: Web and iPhone live voice need sign-in (apps/mobile/src/features/voice/services/liveVoiceAvailability.ts:19). CLI managed transcription needs 'agi login'; other backends need a key or binary (apps/cli/src/voice.rs:127-143).
access_and_usage.permissions: Microphone permission. CLI asks for agreement before recording and states where audio goes (apps/cli/src/voice.rs:379-420).
access_and_usage.subscription: Typing in a call has no rule of its own. Opening voice needs allowVoice on the plan (apps/web/app/api/voice/live/sessions/route.ts:311).
access_and_usage.limits_and_metering: Voice minutes are metered per call (see F048-10). Typing and the typed model turn follow normal chat limits, not voice minutes [inferred]. The CLI records at most 120 seconds and ignores clips under 300 ms (apps/cli/src/voice.rs:36-41).
access_and_usage.model_compatibility: Live voice on web is blocked for chats on a local model or non-managed provider; those chats keep the text composer (apps/web/features/chat/pages/WebChatPage.tsx:5907-5911).
access_and_usage.provider_restrictions: Live voice is managed OpenAI only. CLI transcription may use OpenAI, AGI managed or local whisper.
access_and_usage.local_mode: Web: no voice entry in a Local chat; typing continues as normal. iPhone: 'Live voice runs in AGI Cloud, so Local Mode stays turn based.' (apps/mobile/src/features/voice/services/liveVoiceAvailability.ts:17-18). CLI Local privacy mode: cloud transcription is refused unless AGIWORKFORCE_VOICE_ALLOW_CLOUD=1; a local whisper binary works with no egress (apps/cli/src/voice.rs:62-72, 481-483).

corrections.claim: Web: Enter calls submitTyped, which marks the state as streaming and calls the chat send path; the call stays open
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The reducer sets streaming only from the SUBMITTABLE statuses (listening, muted, transcribing, sending, speaking, error). In any other status the state is unchanged, but onSend is still called. A failed send dispatches fail. The page lists this under Incomplete but the section 6 row states it unconditionally.
corrections.correction: Enter calls submitTyped, which always forwards the text to the chat send path. The state moves to streaming only from listening, muted, transcribing, sending, speaking or error; in other states it stays as it was.

corrections.claim: Subscription: 'Typing in a call has no rule of its own. Opening voice needs allowVoice on the plan' (route.ts:311)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: Line 311 is the allowVoice check. Before it, the route also requires a managed-compute subscription (evaluateManagedComputeSubscriptionAccess) and the canUseVoice capability flag. The Free tier has allowVoice true with voiceMinutesPerMonth 10, so Free can open voice, held to a monthly allowance. Plans with no free allowance go through assessVoiceBudget against the usage budget.
corrections.correction: Opening voice needs a managed-compute subscription state that is allowed, the canUseVoice capability and a plan with allowVoice. Free has allowVoice with 10 minutes a calendar month. Paid plans are charged against the usage budget. Typing has no separate rule.

corrections.claim: Account: 'Web and iPhone live voice need sign-in (liveVoiceAvailability.ts:19)'
corrections.what_the_code_shows: Line 19 is the mobile sign-in reason only; liveVoiceModeUnavailableReason checks Local mode first and then sign-in. The cited file says nothing about web. Web sign-in is not shown by this citation.
corrections.correction: iPhone live voice needs a Cloud chat and a signed-in user (liveVoiceAvailability.ts:19-28). For web, cite the route's auth and scoped-db check in apps/web/app/api/voice/live/sessions/route.ts.

corrections.claim: Provider restrictions: 'Live voice is managed OpenAI only'; limits: CLI records at most 120 seconds and ignores clips under 300 ms
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The 120 s and 300 ms limits are correct (voice.rs:33-39). The live model is the voice_live routing slot, not a fixed OpenAI model. The web gate requires only that the chat's model use a managed provider mode (ManagedGateway or ManagedNative), not OpenAI.
corrections.correction: Web live voice needs a chat on a managed provider route. The live model comes from the voice_live slot, and the backend model from the plan's backend slot.

missing_facts: Free plan voice is capped at 10 minutes per calendar month (voiceMinutesPerMonth: 10), and a session started on that allowance keeps it for its whole length. This is why the 'Continue in text' row exists, but the access table never states the monthly cap: packages/contracts/types/src/model-catalog.ts:1255-1257; apps/web/lib/voice/free-voice-allowance.ts:47-65.

The web route also refuses to open voice for a user whose stored chats may train models, when the live or backend model does not keep inputs out of training, and the chat holds Google user data. The reply is 403 'model_may_train'. This is another reason the user lands in text: apps/web/app/api/voice/live/sessions/route.ts:320-340.

In the CLI, Esc means different things by prompt: at the record prompt it exits voice (voice.rs:574), and at the confirm prompt it discards only that sentence and stays in voice (voice.rs:599). The journey and the page's 'Esc returns to typed session' do not separate the two.
